desktop.notes:
• New app icon (the lion) for Windows (Cullect.exe, taskbar, window) and Android (launcher, adaptive / round).
• Shape tags in the filters (Composition → Shape): Landscape / Portrait / Square / Panorama and the ratio (3:2, 4:3, 16:9, 4:5…). A cropped photo has both - the original's shape and the crop's - plus "Cropped".
• Phone: recent folders on the start screen and when you tap the folder name; hold a photo in the viewer for the menu (share, copy, album, crop, go with the AI, info, place); double-tap in the grid = ★ favourite; Undo shows the photo that came back; the decision frame follows the phone's real edge and corners; tidier top bar.
• Subfolders are included by default (a whole card / trip folder at once).
• AI picks: the AI marks most photos by default (≥ 20 % sure) - slide it right for fewer, surer marks.
